body:
On 22 June, I had the opportunity to present a research poster titled:

"𝐌𝐮𝐥𝐭𝐢-𝐌𝐨𝐝𝐚𝐥 𝐀𝐮𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐈𝐦𝐚𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐅𝐫𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤: 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐮𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐕𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧, 𝐑𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐞 𝐒𝐞𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝟑𝐃 𝐏𝐡𝐨𝐭𝐨𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐦𝐦𝐞𝐭𝐫𝐲 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐌𝐏𝐀 𝐄𝐜𝐨𝐬𝐲𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐦 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐀𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭."

The work brings together multiple imaging technologies to support biodiversity monitoring and ecosystem resilience assessment in Marine Protected Areas (MPAs). By integrating #computer vision, #remote sensing, and 3D #photogrammetry, the framework aims to automate ecological monitoring while providing scalable and repeatable methods for understanding changes in complex marine habitats.
